data.Name: Drogon — Decision Gate 2 DG2 Concept Select
data.Description: DG2 Concept Select for the Drogon field development. Valysar fluvial formation across 7 reservoir segments (NorthSea, NorthHorst, CentralHorst, CentralFlanks, CentralSouth, SouthWing, EastLobe) with three facies types (Channel, Crevasse, Floodplain). Revised petrophysical interpretation: porosity reduced by factor 0.8 based on core analysis and thin sections. 50 FMU realisations quantify STOIIP uncertainty: P90 33.8 / P50 45.4 / P10 59.4 MSm³ oil in-place. Recoverable oil (P50) 14.8 MSm³ at 32.5% recovery factor. Recommended concept: subsea tie-back to FPSO with 2×4-slot templates, 12 production wells. NPV@10% 520 MUSD, CAPEX 8,500 MNOK, first oil 2028-H1.
data.DecisionSummary: Approve subsea tie-back development concept. Two 4-slot templates (8 slots), 12 wells targeting full 7-segment Valysar scope. Reference case STOIIP 45.4 MSm³ (P90 33.8, P10 59.4) — revised porosity interpretation ×0.8. Recoverable oil P50 14.8 MSm³ (RF 32.5%). First oil target 2028-H1. Proceed to DG3 FEED.

Alternatives.Name: Alt-A: Subsea tie-back to FPSO (2×4-slot templates)
Alternatives.Rationale: Highest NPV; leverages planned FPSO conversion for Drogon area. 12 wells across 7 segments, 2×4-slot templates with 2 contingent slots for infill. Subsea boosting pump included for low-pressure phase. Modular water treatment allows staged capacity expansion.

Alternatives.Name: Alt-B: Reduced scope — CentralHorst + CentralSouth only
Alternatives.Rationale: Focus on the two highest-confidence segments (Channel facies dominant, lowest porosity uncertainty). 6 wells, single 4-slot template + 2 satellite wells. Lower investment but captures only ~55% of recoverable resource. Provides first-oil option if FPSO schedule slips.

Alternatives.Name: Alt-C: Defer — acquire DG3-quality appraisal data
Alternatives.Rationale: NorthHorst and EastLobe fault compartmentalisation remains poorly constrained. Additional well test data (est. 12 months, 200 MNOK) would reduce dynamic uncertainty range by ~40%. Risk of losing FPSO drydock window if deferred beyond 2026-Q3.

DevelopmentConcept.Summary: Subsea development with 2×4-slot templates (8 slots + 2 contingent), tie-back to converted FPSO via dual 10" production flowlines and 6" gas-lift line. Distance to FPSO ~8 km. Water depth 108 m. Valysar formation at ~1700 m TVD MSL.
DevelopmentConcept.InjectionStrategy: Water injection for pressure support (4 injectors planned Phase 2)

KeyUncertainties.Description: DG2 appraisal core data have narrowed porosity ranges (revised ×0.8 from DG1): Channel 0.21–0.24, Crevasse 0.15–0.18, Floodplain 0.06–0.10. Impact downgraded from High (DG1) to Medium based on 50-realisation FMU results. STOIIP reduced by ~20% vs DG1.

Production testing confirmed partial communication across CentralHorst–CentralSouth fault. NorthHorst and EastLobe remain untested. 30% probability of needing 2–4 infill wells (80–120 MUSD incremental CAPEX).
OWC refined to 1710 ± 10 m TVDSS (from ±15 m at DG1). Aquifer modelling suggests moderate pressure support, sufficient for primary depletion; water injection reserved for Phase 2.

Dynamic simulation (50 realisations, revised porosity) gives RF range 28–37%. P50 = 32.5%. Absolute recoverable reduced by ~20% vs DG1 (14.8 vs 18.5 MSm³). Main driver is sweep efficiency in NorthHorst and EastLobe where fault baffles may create unswept compartments. ICD completions and Phase 2 water injection are key mitigations.

Water cut expected to reach 50% by Year 5 and 70% by Year 10. FPSO design includes 5,000 m³/d treatment; expansion module to 8,000 m³/d available for Year 7+. Uncertainty in early water breakthrough timing from EastLobe aquifer.

KeyEconomics.Note: Reference case economics from CRA, updated for DG2 revised volumes (porosity ×0.8 → ~20% less STOIIP and recoverable). NPV reduced from DG1's 650 MUSD to 520 MUSD. Breakeven up from $38 to $42/bbl. CAPEX unchanged. Payback extended by 1 year due to lower production rates.

Secure FPSO drydock slot (2027-Q4 target) with dual-yard tendering strategy
Drill NorthHorst appraisal sidetrack to constrain fault compartmentalisation model
Finalise Phase 2 water injection well locations based on DG3 dynamic simulation
Complete EIA with cold-water coral avoidance routing for flowline corridor
Run Level 3+ FMU workflow with 100+ realisations for DG3 volumetric basis
Prepare PDO final draft for MPE submission post-FID
